service_boundary: Represents the Token Factory inference platform, previously presented as Nebius AI Studio. Nebius AI Cloud's general GPU compute and the models served through the platform remain separate boundaries.
regional_controls: Nebius describes data centres in Finland, France, and the United States and states that a dedicated endpoint processes requests only in the selected region, without multi-region routing or automatic overflow. It presents itself as an EU data processor operating under GDPR with a customer-facing data processing agreement.
retention_controls: Nebius documents an account-level zero-data-retention setting under which inputs and outputs are not stored after a request is processed, and describes itself as processor with the customer as controller for content submitted to inference endpoints.
routing: Shared endpoints are served from Nebius capacity with documented rate limits and scaling rules. Dedicated endpoints are explicitly not routed outside their configured region.
customization: Supervised fine-tuning, LoRA and full fine-tuning, adapter merging, custom speculators, and hosting of customer-supplied weights on dedicated endpoints are documented.
strengths: Dedicated endpoints pin processing to one selected region with an explicit statement that there is no multi-region overflow.
Customer-supplied weights, fine-tuning, and adapter lifecycle are first-class rather than adjacent products.
Inference observability and API integrations are documented as part of the service rather than left to the customer.
tradeoffs: The catalogue is open-weight models; first-party frontier models from other developers are not part of the boundary.
The service was recently renamed from Nebius AI Studio, so third-party references and older integration guides may not match current documentation.
Region pinning is documented for dedicated endpoints; shared-endpoint placement is not presented as customer-selected.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Nebius Token Factory inference overview, for Nebius Token Factory

upstream_disclosure.note: The legal quick guide states the operator's role: "for the content you submit to our model inference and fine-tuning endpoints via the API or web interface (prompts, datasets, etc.) and the output you receive, we act as the Data Processor under our DPA."
upstream_disclosure.scope: Nebius Token Factory legal quick guide, for Nebius Token Factory

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: the quickstart's only credential step is "Get API key" from the Token Factory console, and every documented request uses it.
credential_handling.scope: Nebius Token Factory quickstart, for Nebius Token Factory

cache_isolation.note: No prompt or prefix caching scope is documented in the inference overview or elsewhere in the documentation.
cache_isolation.scope: Nebius Token Factory inference overview, for Nebius Token Factory

independent_audit.note: The Token Factory legal quick guide states: "We are a certified company holding ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications." The statement is company-wide but sits in the service's own documentation; the reports are behind a request-access control.
